defs.def: if a part of your body is sore, it is painful, and often red, especially because of infection or because a muscle has been used too much （发炎）疼痛的；酸痛的

ex.s: Symptoms usually start two days to three weeks following infection, and include fever, sore throat, muscular pain and headaches.
ex.t: 症状通常在感染后两天到三周开始出现，包括发热、咽喉痛、肌肉疼痛和头痛。

defs.def: upset and angry, especially because you have been treated unfairly 气恼；愤慨；愤愤不平
